aba62e7bde.title: ما هي أعراض الانسحاب من الكحول؟

messages.content: ما هي أعراض الانسحاب من الكحول؟
تشير الأدلة المتاحة إلى أن أعراض الانسحاب من الكحول تشمل أعراضًا جسديةً ونفسيةً تظهر عندما يقلّ الشخص فجأة كمية استهلاكه للكحول بعد فترات طويلة من الشرب المفرط [S1][S2]

evidence_strength.rationale: Evidence clears the answer gate but is below the provisional strong-evidence baseline.

evidence.excerpt:
The physical and psychological symptoms that people can experience when they suddenly
reduce the amount of alcohol they drink if they have previously been drinking excessively
for prolonged periods of time. [NICE's guideline on alcohol-use disorders: diagnosis and
management of physical complications, terms used in this guideline]

Alcohol-use disorders cover a range of conditions, including:
• hazardous drinking (a pattern of alcohol consumption that increases someone's risk of
harm)

• harmful drinking (a pattern of alcohol consumption that is causing mental or physical
damage)
• alcohol dependence (behavioural, cognitive and physiological factors that typically
include a strong desire to drink alcohol and difficulties in controlling its use)

• acute alcohol withdrawal (the physical and psychological symptoms that people can
experience when they suddenly reduce the amount of alcohol they drink if they have
previously been drinking excessively for prolonged periods of time).

[Adapted from NICE's guideline on alcohol-use disorders: prevention, glossary]

523899b018.title: ما الأدوية المستخدمة في علاج الانسحاب؟

messages.content: ما الأدوية المستخدمة في علاج الانسحاب؟

• acamprosate
• oral naltrexone
• disulfiram.

[NICE's guideline on alcohol-use disorders: diagnosis, assessment and management of
harmful drinking (high-risk drinking) and alcohol dependence, recommendations 1.3.6.1 to
1.3.6.4]
